title: Billing Note — Replacement Plan Check Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
On a policy-number amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the replacement plan check charge follows the installment interval of the Cardinal Billing Account pay plan of the named insured's bound replacement policy — the months between installment due dates after the down payment.

| Bound replacement policy's billing plan | Replacement plan check charge |
|---|---|
| Installments one month apart | 3.00 |
| Installments more than one month apart | 1.50 |
| No installments (paid in full) | None |
| No bound replacement policy on record | None |

The plan read is the one on the replacement policy's billing account, not the plan of the policy being replaced.

**Hypothetical examples.** A replacement policy billed monthly by electronic funds transfer: 3.00. A replacement policy on a plan billed every two months: 1.50. A replacement policy paid in full: none.
